identity: Arabic Wikipedia encyclopedia article on the football club Borussia Dortmund. Structure: a lead paragraph whose subject NP carries three parenthetical German glosses (بالألمانية + Latin script), then an honours summary; a second paragraph on stadium/colours/rivalry/finances; a one-line motto paragraph; then bare section headings each alone on its own line (التاريخ / التأسيس / ملعب فايس فيز 1924 / من عام 1929 حتى 1949) with encyclopedic body prose under them, evidently translated from the German or English article. Register = my doctrine's section L (encyclopedic / reference prose), the same shape as doc_085c979b884f, where I lost the batch to over-cutting.
law: The unit is the printed full stop of the source article, nothing else (LAW 0'). Calibrating on the first 200 tokens (LAW 6), this document's units run about 12-46 tokens, centred near 25; a stretch that welds out past ~50 tokens is an outlier I should distrust, and a stretch under ~10 needs a named mark. Everything below the full stop welds: comma-lists and the 18-name founders' apposition (LAW 3), relative tails (الذي / التي / والذي / والتي / مما), parenthetical Latin-script glosses بالألمانية X (A2b), an abbreviation inside a proper name (e V of e.V., by A1's 'if removing the dot leaves a well-formed name, weld'), digit groups, decimals, thousands separators and year ranges (A2), and colon-introduced lists (A4, prose colon). Connectives are never by themselves a reason to cut: و ف ثم حيث بينما ولهذا ونظرا وتم وأصبح وشهدت وتخطوها all fail test 2 of my checklist. The positive cut evidence in this text is exactly three things: (1) every token immediately before <NL> plus the final token, which are free; (2) asyndetic juxtaposition of two complete finite propositions, which in this register is strong evidence a full stop was removed, because this translator would have written و had there been none; (3) a fronted adverbial or adjunct (محليا / بحسب تقرير / في عام 1913 / على مدار العقود المقبلة / في البداية / ونظرا لعدم) that must attach forward to a following main verb and therefore cannot be a coordinate continuation of what precedes it.
reasoning:
SITE 1, the strongest weld, tokens 9-12 'e V Dortmund'. My A2 says every dot inside a URL or abbreviation is a boundary (hindawi || org ||, الأردن ص || ب). Applied naively that would give '...Borussia 09 e || V || Dortmund ويعرف...'. But A2's cases were standalone colophon fields where the dots created layout-like lines, whereas this e.V. sits inside a parenthetical German gloss, which A2b says is never a boundary (doc_085c979b884f @3/@6 gold: one segment across three scripts). A1's reconciliation decides it: removing the dots leaves the well-formed organisation name Ballspielverein Borussia 09 e V Dortmund, so it welds. The whole lead NP with its three glosses plus هو plus تأسس plus ويقع is one 46-token sentence closing at @45 ألمانيا.
SITE 2, my hardest call, @115 مرات before بينما. Against cutting: بينما is a subordinator of exactly the family my doctrine convicted me on eight times over (حيث, إذ, في حين, غير أن, إلا أن all weld in gold, B2), and checklist rule 2 says a connective is never a reason. For cutting: the reason is not the connective. (a) The preceding sentence announced a two-part frame على الصعيد المحلي والقاري, and محليا at @88 realises the first half as its own sentence, so the parallel بينما على الصعيد القاري والأوروبي is checklist cue 5, 'a topic sentence after a completed argument'. (b) Welding gives one 55-token unit containing two separate colon-lists (موزعة كالتالي: ... and وهي: ...); two colons in one printed sentence is typographically implausible, whereas one colon-list per sentence is the natural encyclopedic shape. (c) 55 tokens is outside this document's measured band; the only 55-token unit I accept here is the enumerated founders' list, which is a list, not two coordinated propositions. I cut, and I mark it lo, because the subordinator is a real counterweight and this is the one site where I could plausibly be adding a false cut.
SITE 3, @393 للسرقة before ويفترض. و + verb-first is the coordinate-continuation shape and my default is weld. I cut anyway, at lo, on two grounds: the preceding clause is already closed off by a مما relative tail, and the topic changes hard from wooden goalposts being removed to the etymology of the ground's name. Welding would give 48 tokens, just outside band. If I am wrong this costs one miss, which is the cheaper error.
SITE 4, @423 البيضاء before ونظرا. Here I cut at med. ونظرا لعدم استيفائه ... خضع إلى بناء is و + fronted causal adjunct + main verb, not و + verb, so it is not a coordinate continuation of وتعني المروج البيضاء (a gloss-translation tail of a German proper name). Welding it forward would produce a 75-token unit, far outside anything in this register except an enumerated list. Cut.
SITE 5, @439 1924 before وأصبح, and @451 متر before وتم بناء. Both welded. These are و + verb-first continuing the very same 1924 rebuilding event (wall, rooms, ticket booth, terrace, capacity); LAW 1 forbids cutting on و, and welding gives 45 tokens, inside band. Note 1 8 is 1.8 metres and 18 000 is 18,000: A2, never cut inside a number.
SITE 6, @468 000. The following بلغت التكلفة الإجمالية is asyndetic with its own finite verb and a new fact (cost), so a stop precedes it. The boundary token is therefore the digit group 000, the tail of 18.000 - which is A2 applied correctly: the segment ends at the end of the sentence containing the number, not inside it.
SITE 7, @526 الديون before وتخطوها. Welded. وتخطوها carries an anaphoric -ها bound to الديون and resolves the same debt event; a four-verb و-chain as one segment is well attested in gold (doc_099def456da2 @183, doc_3762b5d5da2f @95). Welding gives 45 tokens, in band.
SITE 8, @541 الخاص before وشهدت. Cut, med. Same و + verb-first shape as site 7, but here the subject is a new temporal frame (ثلاثينيات القرن العشرين) opening a new topic, Nazi restructuring of sport, and welding would give a 66-token paragraph-long unit, well outside band. This is cue 5 again.
SITE 9, @243-@297, the founders. تأسس النادي ... من قبل مجموعة من الشباب الذين غادروا ... وهم [eighteen names]. This is verbatim the doc_0de3fe1bcb6c thirteen-name run that cost me twelve consecutive false cuts. Zero internal boundaries; the segment is 55 tokens and closes at @297 ويندت, because لقد اتخذوا is asyndetic and لقد is a sentence-initial particle.
SITE 10, @197 الكلاسيكو before بحسب. بحسب تقرير ديلويت لأغنى أندية العالم semantically governs يعتبر نادي دورتموند ثاني أغنى نادي, not the naming of the Klassiker, so it is a forward-attaching fronted PP and the stop falls before it.
